learning_goal: Teach learners to understand and apply the main ideas of 'Vocation'.

explanation_sections.title: Connect
explanation_sections.explanation: Begin with learners' prior experience related to Vocation and invite predictions.

explanation_sections.title: Explore
explanation_sections.explanation: Use the chapter evidence below to build the explanation rather than introducing unsupported facts.
source_evidence: Let us Recite (1) When the gong sounds ten in the morning and I walk to school by our lane, Every day I meet the hawker crying, “Bangles, crystal bangles!” There is nothing to hurry him on, there is no road he must take, no place he must go to, no time when he must come home.

I wish I were a hawker, spending my day in the road, crying, “Bangles, crystal bangles!” 9 Vocation Unit 5: Work is Worship Chapter 9.indd 105 6/10/2025 4:37:17 PM (2) When at four in the afternoon I come back from the school.
I can see through the gate of that house the gardener digging the ground.
He does what he likes with his spade, he soils his clothes with dust, nobody takes him to task if he gets baked in the sun or gets wet.

explanation_sections.title: Make meaning
explanation_sections.explanation: Ask learners to explain what the evidence shows, compare ideas, and justify answers.

explanation_sections.title: Apply
explanation_sections.explanation: Move from a chapter example to a new, closely related example.

teaching_sequence.teacher_action: Model close reading/working with the chapter.

teaching_sequence.student_action: Explain why an answer is supported.

misconceptions: Giving an answer without explaining the reasoning.
checks_for_understanding: What evidence in 'Vocation' supports your answer?
Can you explain the idea in your own words?
closure: Ask the learner to state the most important idea and one way it can be used.
